# Green belt fixture (plan step M5.2)

Real rows captured on 12 Nov 2026 from the planning.data.gov.uk
green-belt file the loader uses live. The full file holds only
181 pieces, but each is a whole district's compilation, so the
fixture keeps six: the pieces for Epsom and Ewell, Sutton,
Kingston upon Thames and Newham, plus one Birmingham-core and
one Merseyside and Greater Manchester-core piece to prove the
naming rule — a piece is named by its belt (green-belt-core),
never by the district that compiled it.

Golden facts these rows must reproduce: no golden home falls
inside a piece; the Epsom flat sits 0.101 miles outside the
London belt (the Epsom and Ewell district piece, whose own
`name` in the file is "Epsom and Ewell" and must not be
served); and no piece exists for Braintree district
(E07000067) — absence here is genuine, because MHCLG compiles
every local authority's return.
